messages:
mia_finance: Heads up — PartnerNimbus flagged an unexpected spike on invoice INV-2026-442 and is asking for a one-time credit. Need deal-desk / finance approval to proceed.

trevor_sales: how big is the spike? any contractual levers (commits / pilot credits)? :eyes:

mia_finance: quick summary:
```
invoice_id: INV-2026-442
period: 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28
billed_tokens: 3,120,450
expected_tokens (run rate): ~520,000
line_item_issue: duplicate ingestion job + misrouted batch for 2 days
requested_credit: $18,200 (customer calc)
```
We validated ingest logs and saw duplicate batches from 2026-02-14 03:00 - 2026-02-15 22:00. Suggest one-off credit of $18,200 or cap to 2x normal run-rate for that period.

zara_ops: we rolled a fix on 2026-03-01 and disabled the bad job. Confirmed no further duplicates. Will supply a short bulletin for the customer. PR: https://git.redwood/srv/ingest/pull/238 :white_check_mark:

sam_legal: Contract clause 4.2 covers service credits for platform errors but not duplicate user-triggered jobs. If we grant full credit, recommend an amended SOW that clarifies ingestion SLAs and limits. + require incident RCA.

carlos_fd: provisional approval from finance: we can approve a one-time credit up to $15,000 without exec signoff. Anything above needs VP signoff. Can we split: immediate $15k now, remainder subject to RCA?

mia_finance: proposal: apply $15,000 immediate credit, hold $3,200 pending customer acknowledgement of the RCA and updated SOW. If legal ok, we can finalize remainder within 10 business days.

trevor_sales: PartnerNimbus is ok w/ staged approach if we send a short note and timeline. I'll draft.

maya_engineering: logs/export attached in the ticket — confirm the duplicate was from a mis-scheduled cron in their pipeline that retried the same job. We can provide a checksum diff for reconciliation if they need it.

sam_legal: ok to proceed with staged credit. I'll prepare a short amendment template (1 paragraph) and ask for the customer sign-off clause.

mia_finance: action items: 1) trevor to send staged-credit note to customer today 2) zara to drop bulletin + RCA summary into the support ticket 3) legal to draft amendment 4) finance to apply $15,000 credit once trevor confirms customer acknowledgement.

InvoicerBot: CREDIT_APPLY_REQUEST created: ref=CR-2553337890-1 amount=15000 status=pending (linked to INV-2026-442)

carlos_fd: marking provisional approved. Please ping me when the customer signs amendment for the remaining $3,200. :+1:

mia_finance: thanks all — will update thread as items close.
